summary: Lays out the message exchange between two Network Control Programs needed to carry out the Initial Connection Protocol in RFC 123. It shows the server and user sides step by step. It was replaced by RFC 145, which corrected an error in it.

eli5.summary: Two people on a phone call each write down exactly which words they say, one after another. This note is that script for starting a computer connection.

questions: what ncp commands does the icp use
how does the initial connection protocol work step by step
